title: poa rigens subsp. colpodea
intro: Poa rigens subsp. colpodea, commonly known as Blue Tussock Grass, is a subspecies of grass native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its traditional uses in medicine, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa rigens subsp. colpodea are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are primarily phenolic acids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which have been identified in various studies on the plant's chemical composition.
